summary: Acquittal appeal against appellate court conviction; appellate court erred reappreciating evidence in absence of trial court perversity; presumption of innocence reinforced by trial acquittal; single witness evidence insufficient for conviction; individual acts standard applied; A3 role limited to chili powder/assault without lethal weapons; no hearing on sentence quantum violated Section 235(2) CrPC; all convictions set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Rohtash vs. State of Haryana (2012) 6 SCC 589
Darshan Singh & others vs. State of Punjab (2009) 16 SCC 290
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court conviction set aside; acquittals restored for all accused including A1 and A3; no sentence imposed.
